layers.name: L0 — Организм и границы
layers.role: Идентичность, persistence, host/device boundary, body/environment boundary
layers.comment: Есть хорошая инженерная граница, но biological embodiment ещё неполный.

layers.name: L1 — Макроанатомические системы
layers.role: Кора, таламус, базальные ганглии, мозжечок, гипоталамус, brainstem, hippocampal formation, limbic systems
layers.current: Часть представлена функциональными engines; explicit anatomy отсутствует для многих систем
layers.comment: Нужна anatomical ontology, а не ещё один набор P-модулей.

layers.name: L2 — Сетевые функциональные системы
layers.role: DMN, salience, frontoparietal/control, attention, action mode, memory networks, interoceptive/allostatic network
layers.current: Workspace, attention schema, social/world/self systems, allostasis
layers.comment: Сетевые функции уже сильнее, чем анатомическая детализация.

layers.name: L3 — Микросхемы
layers.role: Laminar cortex, hippocampal DG/CA3/CA1, striatal pathways, cerebellar microcircuit, thalamic loops
layers.comment: Это следующий научный уровень после сетевого мозга.

layers.name: L4 — Клетки
layers.role: Excitatory/inhibitory neuronal classes, glia, vascular/immune cells
layers.current: Абстрактные computational units, без cell atlas
layers.comment: Нужен cell ontology и cell-role library.

layers.name: L5 — Синапсы и молекулы
layers.role: Synapses, receptors, ion channels, dendrites, second messengers
layers.comment: Можно делать biologically-inspired abstraction без буквального molecular simulation.

layers.name: L6 — Динамика
layers.role: Spikes, oscillations, synchrony, phase, recurrent states, neuromodulatory pulses
layers.current: Recurrent latent states, replay, timing, resource pressure

layers.name: L7 — Тело
layers.role: Interoception, autonomic, endocrine, immune, metabolism, sensorimotor loops
layers.current: Predictive allostasis, resource allocator, phone body

layers.name: L8 — Развитие
layers.role: Development, critical periods, pruning, myelination, learning trajectory
layers.comment: Сильный computational base, biological constraints отсутствуют.

layers.name: L9 — Сознание и субъективность
layers.role: No consensus single mechanism; multiple theories

project_comparison.current: Центральный рекуррентный мозг, recurrent global workspace, attention schema, semantic perception, cognitive kernel
project_comparison.gap: Нет реального многомасштабного cortical sheet, columnar microcircuitry, 360-area anatomical map, laminar processing.

project_comparison.current: HippocampalMemorySubstrate, AutobiographicalMemory, replay, MemoryOS2, temporal memory
project_comparison.evaluation: Сильная computational реализация fast episode → replay → slow schema
project_comparison.gap: Нет моделирования DG/CA3/CA1/entorhinal/subiculum как отдельных interacting circuits; нет cellular oscillations / SWR dynamics.

project_comparison.current: SelfModelValidationEngine, AgencyDeliberationEngine, goal ecology, executive/developmental engines
project_comparison.evaluation: Есть функции executive control, planning, metacognition
project_comparison.gap: Не разделены OFC/VM-PFC/dlPFC/ACC/polar cortex, рабочая память не представлена laminar/recurrent microcircuits.

project_comparison.evaluation: Часть routing/global broadcast выполняется workspace/event fabric
project_comparison.gap: Нет явного thalamic relay/gating/arousal architecture; это один из крупнейших anatomical gaps.
Нет явных striatum/direct-indirect/hyperdirect loops, SNc/VTA pathways, habit vs goal-directed anatomical separation.

project_comparison.evaluation: Есть prediction/error/skill learning в learning stack
project_comparison.gap: Нет cerebellar forward models, Purkinje/granule architecture, climbing-fiber teaching signal, timing/coordination subsystem.

project_comparison.current: Predictive allostasis, resource allocator, phone thermal/resource policy
project_comparison.gap: Нет anatomical endocrine/autonomic controller, HPA-like axes, hypothalamic nuclei, appetite/thermoregulation/reproductive/homeostatic loops.
Нет locus coeruleus, raphe, cholinergic brainstem, PAG, NTS/PBN, reticular formation as explicit circuits.
Нет explicit insular subdivisions, ACC/pACC/sgACC topology, visceromotor loops.
Нет explicit amygdala nuclei / threat-safety learning circuitry.
Нет explicit social perceptual circuits (STS, TPJ, dmPFC, temporal poles) and their causal routing.

project_comparison.current: PerceptionRouter, semantic perception, camera/voice, multimodal situation model
project_comparison.gap: Нет биологически структурированных V1/V2/V4/MT, auditory hierarchy, somatosensory body map, olfactory/vestibular pathways.
Нет explicit M1/premotor/SMA/basal-ganglia/cerebellar/spinal controller hierarchy.
Нет astrocyte, oligodendrocyte, microglia dynamics. Это крупный missing layer.
Нет neurovascular coupling, BBB, glucose/oxygen delivery, lactate, CSF/interstitial dynamics.
Нет полноценного circadian/ultradian sleep architecture, NREM/REM state machine, oscillatory coupling.

project_comparison.evaluation: Есть scalar neuromodulators and plasticity abstractions
project_comparison.gap: Нет receptor-level signaling, ion channels, dendritic computation, synapse lifecycle.
Нет biological developmental constraints, critical periods, synaptic overproduction/pruning, myelination trajectories.
Нет neuroimmune coupling / microglial inflammatory states.

project_comparison.current: RecurrentGlobalWorkspace, metacognition, consciousness evidence ledger, adversarial harness
project_comparison.gap: Никакого доказанного феноменального сознания; biological substrate is not reproduced.

brain_systems.name: Кора больших полушарий
brain_systems.human: 360 cortical areas in HCP-MMP1.0; multimodal borders derived from thickness, myelin, rfMRI and task activation
brain_systems.target: Target: 360-area functional ontology + hierarchy + inter-area graph + hemisphere asymmetry
brain_systems.current: Current project: central recurrent brain / cognition / workspace

brain_systems.name: Гиппокампальная формация
brain_systems.human: DG, CA fields, subiculum, entorhinal/parahippocampal interfaces; episodic encoding, retrieval, pattern separation/completion
brain_systems.target: Target: explicit subcircuits + replay/SWR-like dynamics + consolidation routing

brain_systems.name: Таламус
brain_systems.human: Distributed relay/integration; whole-brain influence and adaptive behaviour
brain_systems.target: Target: relay-specific channels, thalamocortical gating, state-dependent gain

brain_systems.name: Базальные ганглии
brain_systems.human: Action selection, instrumental learning, habits; striatal pathways
brain_systems.target: Target: direct/indirect/hyperdirect loops + dopamine learning + habitization

brain_systems.name: Мозжечок
brain_systems.human: Predictive motor control, error correction, internal models, timing
brain_systems.target: Target: fast predictor/controller separate from global cognition

brain_systems.name: Гипоталамус + brainstem
brain_systems.target: Target: homeostatic variables, endocrine/autonomic loops, arousal controller

brain_systems.name: Лимбические системы
brain_systems.human: Amygdala, cingulate, hippocampal interfaces, vmPFC/OFC; valuation and affective learning
brain_systems.target: Target: threat/safety, affective memory, value arbitration

brain_systems.name: Сенсорные hierarchies
brain_systems.human: Visual, auditory, somatosensory, vestibular, olfactory systems
brain_systems.target: Target: modality-specific hierarchical encoders and body maps

brain_systems.name: Motor systems
brain_systems.human: M1, premotor, SMA, basal ganglia, cerebellum, spinal/brainstem pathways

brain_systems.name: Glia/immune/vascular
brain_systems.human: Astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, microglia, BBB, neurovascular coupling
brain_systems.target: Target: support, repair, plasticity, metabolic constraints
brain_systems.current: Current: almost entirely absent as explicit mechanisms

roadmap.title: Freeze + ontology
roadmap.content: Do not code; establish canonical artificial brain ontology and evidence standards.

roadmap.title: Anatomical graph
roadmap.content: Introduce one brain-wide ontology describing regions, systems, pathways, timescales, owners and evidence.

roadmap.title: Thalamocortical gate
roadmap.content: Model state-dependent routing / broadcast / gain with explicit channels.

roadmap.title: Basal-ganglia action loop
roadmap.content: Goal-directed vs habit policy, direct/indirect/hyperdirect abstraction, dopamine teaching signal.

roadmap.title: Cerebellar predictor
roadmap.content: Separate fast sensorimotor prediction/error correction from deliberative brain.

roadmap.title: Brainstem + neuromodulatory nuclei
roadmap.content: Arousal, novelty, uncertainty, attention gain, sleep/wake and global mode control.
roadmap.criterion: Make existing scalar neuromodulators anatomically grounded

roadmap.title: Hypothalamus / allostasis / body
roadmap.content: Synthetic endocrine/autonomic state machine; hunger, temperature, energy, pain, stress, immune load.
roadmap.criterion: Unify body state instead of scalar load

roadmap.title: Insula/ACC/limbic affect
roadmap.content: Visceromotor and affective appraisal loops tied to body and memory.

roadmap.title: Sensory and motor maps
roadmap.content: Build modality-specific hierarchies and body maps; retain high-level semantic backends.
roadmap.criterion: Embodiment becomes causal, not only semantic

roadmap.title: Glia + vascular + metabolic
roadmap.content: Introduce low-cost support layer: synaptic support, myelination/latency, pruning, resource supply, repair.

roadmap.title: Microcircuit tier
roadmap.content: Implement selective microcircuits: cortical column motif, DG/CA3/CA1, striatal loop, cerebellar microcircuit.

roadmap.title: Oscillations / synchrony
roadmap.content: Theta/gamma/SWR-like events, phase coupling, cortical state modes.

roadmap.title: Sleep / offline consolidation
roadmap.content: NREM/REM-like states, replay prioritization, consolidation, forgetting, dream simulation.

roadmap.title: Developmental maturation
roadmap.content: Critical periods, pruning, myelination, skill stages, developmental constraints.

roadmap.title: Brain-wide causal battery
roadmap.content: Lesion/ablation/intervention matrix for every major subsystem and pathway.
roadmap.criterion: No subsystem accepted by presence alone

roadmap.title: Longitudinal human-like organism
roadmap.content: Months-scale identity, social, learning, body and environmental adaptation.

roadmap.title: Physical Android brain
roadmap.content: Map synthetic brain state to actual sensors/actuators and mobile constraints.

roadmap.title: Consciousness research tier
roadmap.criterion: No consciousness claim without causal evidence

roadmap.title: Final whole-organism integration
roadmap.criterion: Artificial organism rather than module collection

ai_neuro.evidence: Strong contextual integration; useful high-level language and multimodal reasoning
ai_neuro.implication: Keep as language/interface layer, not as entire brain.

ai_neuro.evidence: Sequence memory can improve sample/memory efficiency in control
ai_neuro.implication: Directly relevant to current hippocampal branch.
Already central to world model; should be tied more tightly to body/active inference.

ai_neuro.evidence: Dopamine, noradrenaline, acetylcholine, serotonin modulate learning/attention/exploration
ai_neuro.implication: Existing scalar implementation should become anatomically and causally grounded.

ai_neuro.evidence: Potential efficiency and local learning, especially event-driven systems
ai_neuro.implication: Interesting future phone/hardware path; not necessary for current semantic runtime.

ai_neuro.evidence: Dendrites offer alternative mechanisms for credit assignment, continual learning, energy efficiency
ai_neuro.implication: Potential source for local plasticity in future microcircuit layer.

ai_neuro.evidence: Bidirectional field: neuroscience informs AI, AI accelerates neuroscience; interpretability vs engineering power is a key tension
ai_neuro.implication: Use AI for scientific mapping and use neuroscience for constrained architecture.

ai_neuro.evidence: Intelligence emerges in closed perception-action loops rather than pure text generation
ai_neuro.implication: Critical for final target; existing body/world/action branches should be unified.
